question: A patient registered under NTEP for TB treatment can simultaneously be enrolled in the NACO programme for HIV care at the same PHC.

l10n.wrongAnswerMessage: A patient can — and should — be enrolled in multiple national health programmes simultaneously when co-morbidities exist. TB-HIV co-management under NTEP and NACO is a well-established collaborative framework.
l10n.correctAnswerMessage: Correct. TB-HIV co-infection is common, and co-enrolment in both NTEP and NACO (for antiretroviral therapy and isoniazid preventive therapy) is standard practice under the collaborative TB-HIV activities framework.
